_comment: Retopology models of the Scenario API. Edit this file to add a model,
adjust a range or drop one that is gone, without touching any Python.
A user copy at <Blender config>/sb_ai_retopo_models.json overrides this
file and survives reinstalling the add-on; write one with the
'Export Model List' button in the add-on preferences.
density: 'count' for models taking a target face count, 'level' for
models offering only low/medium/high. file_param, polygon_param and
count_param/level_param are the names this model expects in the request
body. polygon_values maps the panel's quads/tris choice onto whatever
the model calls it. extra is sent verbatim.
Removed on purpose: model_meshy-remesh. Its parameters were file param
'model', topology quad/triangle, targetPolycount 100 to 300000 with a
default of 30000, plus extra resizeHeight 0 and originAt 'empty'. It
was rejected for this account; the reason was never read off the API
response, so it may well be usable. Check with 'Refresh Catalogue' and
paste the entry back if the id shows up.
